import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import re
import os

# Set paths
input_dir = Path("./input")
submission_dir = Path("./submission")
submission_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv(input_dir / "en_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv(input_dir / "en_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(input_dir / "en_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Unique 'after' values: {len(train['after'].drop_duplicates())}")

# Build exact match dictionary properly (fixed version)
exact_map = {}
for i, row in train.iterrows():
    if pd.notna(row["after"]):
        key = row["before"]
        if key not in exact_map:
            exact_map[key] = set()
        exact_map[key].add(row["after"])

print(f"Training rows processed: {len(exact_map)}")

# Filter training data
valid_mask = train["after"].notna() & train["before"].notna()
print(
    f"Valid training samples: {valid_mask.sum():,} / {len(train):,} ({100*valid_mask.mean():.1f}% kept)"
)
train_clean = train[valid_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

# Merge id columns
train_clean["id"] = train_clean.apply(
    lambda r: f"{r['sentence_id']}_{r['token_id']}", axis=1
)
test["id"] = test.apply(lambda r: f"{r['sentence_id']}_{r['token_id']}", axis=1)

# Label encoder
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
labels = sorted(train_clean["after"].drop_duplicates())
print(f"Total unique labels: {len(labels)}")
label_encoder.fit(labels)


# Use class as feature + text representation
def make_features(text_row):
    text = str(text_row["before"])
    feats = [
        len(text),
        int(bool(re.search(r"\d", text))),
        int(bool(re.search(r"[a-zA-Z]", text))),
        int(bool(re.search(r"^[a-zA-Z]", text))) if len(text) > 0 else 0,
        int(bool(re.search(r"^\.\W*\d", text))) if len(text) > 0 else 0,
        int(bool(re.search(r"\d\d?\.", text))),
        int(re.search(r"\d{3,}", text)) if re.search(r"\d{3,}", text) else 0,
        int((text_row["class"] == "PLAIN").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "PUNCT").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "DATE").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "LETTERS").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "NUMBER").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "ORDINAL").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "URL").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "EMAIL").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "MONEY").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "PERCENT").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "TIME").astype(int)),
        int((text_row["class"] == "CURRENCY").astype(int)),
    ]
    # First char types
    if len(text) > 0:
        first_char = text[0]
        feats.append(1 if first_char.isdigit() else 0)
        feats.append(1 if first_char.isalpha() else 0)
        feats.append(1 if first_char in ".,;:!?'\"()-+*/=%&$£€" else 0)
        feats.append(1 if first_char.isdigit() else 0)
    return feats


print("\nExtracting features...")
X_train = np.array([make_features(r) for _, r in train_clean.iterrows()])
y_train = label_encoder.transform(train_clean["after"])
print(f"Features extracted: {X_train.shape}")

# Create proper hold-out validation split (80/20)
print("\nCreating hold-out validation split...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)
print(f"Train split: {X_tr.shape}, Val split: {X_val.shape}")

# Train MLP classifier
print("\nTraining MLP classifier...")
clf = MLPClassifier(
    hidden_layer_sizes=(256, 128, 64),
    max_iter=200,
    random_state=42,
    early_stopping=True,
    validation_fraction=0.1,
    n_iter_no_change=10,
    tol=1e-4,
    learning_rate_init=0.001,
    solver="adam",
)
clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on hold-out set (model was NOT trained on this data)
print("\nValidating on hold-out set...")
val_preds = clf.predict(X_val)
val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"HOLD-OUT VALIDATION ACCURACY: {val_acc:.6f}")

# Process test set
print("\nProcessing test set...")
test["feat"] = test.apply(lambda r: make_features(r), axis=1)
X_test = np.array([[r["feat"]] for _, r in test.iterrows()])

test_preds = clf.predict(X_test)
test_preds_labels = label_encoder.inverse_transform(test_preds)

# Ensure no None predictions
if hasattr(test_preds_labels, "astype"):
    common_class = train_clean["after"].mode().iloc[0] if len(train_clean) > 0 else ","
    # Handle any unexpected values
    valid_after = label_encoder.classes_
    test_preds_labels = np.where(
        np.isin(test_preds_labels, [None]), common_class, test_preds_labels
    )

# Save submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "after": test_preds_labels.tolist()})
submission_df.to_csv(submission_dir / "submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {submission_dir / 'submission.csv'}")
